behavior: Sort enumerable string object keys lexicographically by default and recursively.
Preserve array order and native JSON treatment of undefined, non-finite numbers, and escaping.
Accept a comparator function directly or opts.cmp with {key,value} records and a get(key) helper.
Accept opts.replacer, opts.space, opts.cycles, and opts.collapseEmpty with documented error behavior.
public_api.side_effects: Calls user-provided toJSON, comparator, and replacer callbacks; no filesystem or network access.
errors: TypeError for circular input unless cycles is true
public_api.source_basis: Frozen upstream package metadata and implementation inventory; behavioral contract is specified in instruction.md.

risk_adaptation: Callbacks and circular object graphs are exercised through a UID-separated JSON child adapter; the adapter constructs non-JSON values inside the candidate child.
